name: Plant Panic
description: Plant rescue for a very chaotic household: who is thirsty, how healthy everyone is, and plant number 5 must survive.
schema: CREATE TABLE plants (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), n INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Fern', trait TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', health INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, thirsty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, born TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now','localtime')), art TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '/img/five-w.png', color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#16A34A')

card.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM plants WHERE thirsty = 1) AS thirsty, (SELECT count(*) FROM plants) AS alive
